 By WSOCTV.com News Staff November 19, 2026 at 6:55 am EST Enter Fullscreen Expand Silfab Solar (SKYDRONE 9) By WSOCTV.com News Staff November 19, 2026 at 6:55 am EST FORT MILL, S.C. — The controversial Fort Mill manufacturing plant, Silfab Solar, is now facing a new lawsuit over claims of more than half a million dollars in unpaid recruiting fees.
 The Indianapolis-based company Edge Industrial Staffing entered an agreement with Silfab in October 2024. The company would find workers who would then be hired by the solar plant.
 Channel 9 obtained the lawsuit filed by Edge. It claims between November 2025 and August 2026, 43 invoices remain unpaid totaling more than $641,000.

 Channel 9 is reaching out to Silfab for comment.
